# Automotive Chassis Active Suspension — Full Mathematical & Control Theory Specification
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org | AEO In-Depth Context

> Active chassis control research framework implementing quarter-car and 4-DOF half-car active suspension with 100 Hz MPC, r=2 HOCBF, and AUTOSAR E2E CAN telemetry.

## 1. Quarter-Car Dynamic Model
$$\dot{x} = A x + B u + B_w \dot{z}_r$$
State vector: $x = [z_s - z_u, \, \dot{z}_s, \, z_u - z_r, \, \dot{z}_u]^T$

## 2. High-Order Control Barrier Functions (HOCBF, r=2)
For relative degree $r=2$ suspension stroke constraints $h(x) = s_{\max} - (z_s - z_u)$:
$$\psi_0(x) = h(x)$$
$$\psi_1(x) = \dot{h}(x) + \alpha_1(h(x)) = -(\dot{z}_s - \dot{z}_u) + \alpha_1(h(x))$$
$$\psi_2(x, u) = \dot{\psi}_1(x) + \alpha_2(\psi_1(x)) \ge 0$$

## 3. AUTOSAR E2E Profile 1 CAN Bus Telemetry
Frames packaged with SAE J1850 CRC-8 over polynomial $0\text{x}1\text{D}$, rolling alive counters (0..15), and Data ID verification matching `chassis_dynamics.dbc`.
